models.name: todo_list_system_configurations
models.description:
System configuration key-value storage for the Todo List application.

Stores system-wide parameters and settings that control application behavior and feature toggles. Each configuration entry contains a unique key name, associated string value, human-readable description, and lifecycle timestamps. This facilitates dynamic configuration without requiring code changes or system redeployment.

Configurations are managed independently and may be updated by administrators or system processes. The table supports soft deletion to preserve audit trails and enable recovery if necessary.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier used for lookup and management.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as string, typically representing a setting or parameter value.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of the configuration entry and its purpose.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration entry was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when the entry was marked deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_list_guests
models.description:
Guests who visit the Todo List application without registration.

This table stores basic guest visitor information for tracking anonymous sessions and limited interaction capabilities.
Guests represent unregistered users visiting the platform with no authentication requirements.

Each guest has a unique UUID primary key and temporal fields for creation and updates.

plainFields.name: visitor_ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest visitor for tracking purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

models.name: todo_list_guest_sessions
models.description:
Session records for guest visitors of the Todo List application.

Tracks anonymous sessions for guests, including connection context and session lifecycle details.

Each session belongs to exactly one guest, enabling session-based interaction tracking without authentication.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest who owns this session. {@link todo_list_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the session connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL for the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration time, null if session is currently active.

models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Registered users who can create, read, update, and delete their own todo items.

This table stores user authentication credentials, including secure password hashes and contact emails.

Each user record contains a unique UUID primary key along with timestamps for auditing purposes.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address used for authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure user authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user was soft deleted, if applicable.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration time, null if session is currently active.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Todo list items representing individual tasks managed by registered users.

Each todo item is uniquely identified and owned by a user. The model supports task metadata including title, optional description, completion status, and standard timestamps for creation, updates, and soft deletion.

Ownership is enforced via a foreign key to the todo_list_users table ensuring that users can only manage their own todo items.

Soft deletion is implemented to allow reversible deletion while preserving historical audit trails.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user of the todo item. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item, required and limited to a reasonable length for usability.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo item providing additional context and information.

plainFields.name: is_complete
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the todo item is marked as completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating soft deletion status; null if not deleted.
